answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The comet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ivory is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing.
